title: 載子耗盡相位調變
summary: 以反向接面耗盡、複數折射率與電光限制為主軸，完成 4 階段、24 項模型與判讀作業；包含定量算例、量測基準、失效區分與封裝交接。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address Reverse-junction depletion, complex index and electro-optic limits, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。
scopeEn: Public principles and reproducible hypothetical examples, not foundry recipes, tool settings or product acceptance limits. Representative photos and concept diagrams are not images of each actual process operation.

steps.title: 定義接面與反向偏壓：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Define junction and reverse bias: model and design
steps.objective: 建立定義接面與反向偏壓的可驗證模型及適用邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a verifiable model and validity boundary for define junction and reverse bias.
steps.instruction: 先標出「定義接面與反向偏壓」的座標、光／電／熱輸入與輸出。反向偏壓擴大耗盡區，改變與光模態重疊的自由載子，不是注入大量少數載子。 用至少兩個設計狀態比較本單元變數，寫出能被量測推翻的預測；在工作台依師傅示意判讀相關介面，保留假設與未知參數。
steps.instructionEn: Mark the coordinates and optical/electrical/thermal inputs and outputs for define junction and reverse bias. Reverse bias widens depletion and changes free carriers overlapping the mode, rather than injecting many minority carriers. Compare at least two design states and write a prediction that measurement could falsify. Review the relevant interfaces with the mentor view and preserve assumptions and unknown parameters.
steps.observation: 畫 p/n 區、電壓極性與耗盡變化方向。
steps.observationEn: Draw p/n regions, voltage polarity and depletion expansion.
steps.failure: 錯誤推論「耗盡調變就是正向注入載子」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
steps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "Depletion modulation is forward carrier injection" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
steps.check: 提交定義接面與反向偏壓的變數表、兩種狀態與量測判別紀錄：畫 p/n 區、電壓極性與耗盡變化方向。 寫明剩餘不確定度與不支持的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit variables, two states and a measurement-discrimination record for define junction and reverse bias: Draw p/n regions, voltage polarity and depletion expansion. State remaining uncertainty and unsupported conclusions.

knowledge.textEn: Draw p/n regions, voltage polarity and depletion expansion. Do not infer: Depletion modulation is forward carrier injection

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設已知有效折射率改變 Δn_eff=−2×10⁻⁴、L=2 mm、λ=1550 nm，單一路徑 Δφ=2πΔn_effL/λ=−1.621 rad。另取集總 R=50 Ω、C=100 fF，f_RC=1/(2πRC)=31.83 GHz；這個電氣單極估計不是整體電光頻寬。 Δn_eff 是自行指定的有號模態差，未由某劑量或偏壓保證；載子濃度、重疊、吸收、電容與 RF 傳輸必須以同一截面及偏壓驗證。
knowledge.textEn: With hypothetical known Δn_eff=−2×10⁻⁴, L=2 mm and λ=1550 nm, single-path Δφ=−1.621 rad. Separately, lumped R=50 Ω and C=100 fF give f_RC=31.83 GHz; this electrical single-pole estimate is not total electro-optic bandwidth. Δn_eff is an independently chosen signed modal difference, not guaranteed by a dose or bias. Carrier distribution, overlap, absorption, capacitance and RF propagation must be validated for the same cross-section and bias.

Carrier distribution, overlap, absorption, capacitance and RF propagation must be validated for the same cross-section and bias.
